problemStatement.browserObservation: A stale or unverifiable courtos_session cookie can cause protected pages such as /honglusi to render a Next.js Runtime Error instead of returning to /login.
problemStatement.securityDisposition: Fail closed by denying protected page access and redirecting to login; do not treat auth-service uncertainty as authenticated.

focused: cd frontend && TMPDIR=/tmp TEMP=/tmp TMP=/tmp node --test src/lib/requireUser.test.ts

browser: open http://127.0.0.1:3002/honglusi with a stale session cookie and verify /login?next=%2Fhonglusi without Runtime Error

stopConditions: origin/ext-dev differs from the expected parent before any commit or push
any backend, Harness, authority, systemd, P01, P10 or P14 path changes
protected page content is exposed when auth validation is uncertain
login redirect drops or mutates the protected next path
